SETTINGS_IMAGE_INFO_RESOLUTION: A target resolution will automatically be calculated based on the Megapixel and Aspect Ratio choices, however you can override and put in a resolution you desire. Be careful as resolutions should be divisible by 8 and should match what the model is trained to generate. Changing this can result in poor or failed image generation

SETTINGS_IMAGE_INFO_SEED: Copy and paste a seed # here from a previous generated image to recreate that image. Clear if you wish the images to be random and not deterministic. SETTINGS_IMAGE_INFO_SHOW_PREVIEW: Turn off if you want to hide a preview of the image as it is being generated.
SETTINGS_IMAGE_INFO_SAFETY_CHECKER: Adjust up to increase the likelihood of inappropriate images being censored. Adjust down to decrease the sensitivity to censoring of images

DEMO_CHAT_GENERATE_HELP_TEXT: help me write a research paper on cats ...

DEMO_STARTING_TIP: AI Playground works similar to online AI Tools but runs offline using your own hardware to generate. To get started select a mode like Chat, Image Gen, or Image Edit to get started.
DEMO_CHAT_TIP: Select Chat to ask a general knowledge questions, or Click the “+” icon to load a document or image to get an answer about it
DEMO_CHAT_FOLLOWUP_TIP: When enabled, Chat Settings expose presets for Reasoning, Vision, Agentic and more, where you can add or select models to use, set the token limits, and target a processors for use.
DEMO_IMAGE_GEN_TIP: With Image Gen selected simply describe an image to generate, describe a scene, a character, their look, the background, the mood and style
DEMO_IMAGE_GEN_FOLLOWUP_TIP: Image Gen Settings, when enabled, will give you access to options to generate using different quality, control the likeness of characters, and set the resolution and aspect ratio of the final image
DEMO_IMAGE_EDIT_TIP: Image Edit has the Edit By Prompt feature already enabled. Try it by typing how this image should change, such as ‘remove people’
DEMO_IMAGE_EDIT_FOLLOWUP_TIP: Additionally Image Edit settings will give you access to additional image editing tools like Image Upscale, Inpaint, Outpaint, 2D to 3D Models and more
PRODUCT_MODE_ESSENTIALS_DESCRIPTION: Focused feature set, purpose built for low power, lightweight, and power efficient Intel® Core™ Series 3 Processors.
PRODUCT_MODE_STUDIO_DESCRIPTION: Full feature set of demanding offline AI workloads across chat, vision, image and video using Intel® Core™ Ultra Processors or Intel® Arc™ GPUs.
PRODUCT_MODE_STUDIO_SUPPORTED_HARDWARE: Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 3, Series 2V/2H, Series 1H with 16GB RAM; Intel Arc GPU Series A & B with 8GB of vRAM

SETUP_WIZARD_BACKENDS_INTRO: Required components will be installed automatically. Optional components can be toggled on or off.
SETUP_WIZARD_UNAVAILABLE_TOOLTIP: This component is not available in the selected hardware mode.

SETUP_WIZARD_DEMO_MODE_TOGGLE_OFF: Toggle off to disable Shared Use Mode

DEMO_MODE_SETUP_STORED_USER: Saved in your own settings: applies only to you.
DEMO_MODE_SETUP_STORED_MACHINE: Saved for this computer: applies to all users. Saving asks for administrator approval.
DEMO_MODE_SETUP_PASSCODE_KEEP: Leave blank to keep the current passcode

DEMO_MODE_SETUP_RESET_TIMEOUT_INVALID: Enter a whole number of seconds, at least 1.
DEMO_MODE_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the Demo Mode settings.
DEMO_MODE_SETUP_PASSCODE_UNHASHED: The current Demo Passcode was set by hand and is not stored safely. Set a new one to save.
MODEL_MANAGER_NEEDS_SELECTION_DOWNLOAD: Select one or more models that are not downloaded yet.
MODEL_MANAGER_NEEDS_SELECTION_DELETE: Select one or more models that are on disk.
MODEL_MANAGER_NO_RESULTS: No models match your search and filters.
MODEL_MANAGER_READ_ONLY: The model folder is read-only, so models cannot be downloaded or deleted on this machine.
MODEL_MANAGER_EDIT_DESCRIPTION: These values override what the model catalog reports. They decide which presets can use the model, so correcting them here is how a mislabeled model becomes usable.
MODEL_MANAGER_DELETE_PERMANENT: This deletes the files permanently. They do not go to the system trash and cannot be recovered.
MODEL_MANAGER_DELETE_STAYS_LISTED: Models from the catalog stay listed afterwards and can be downloaded again at any time.
MODEL_MANAGER_CAP_CODING_HINT: Include this model in Game Agent and Quick Coder. Only models marked for coding appear in those presets.
MODEL_MANAGER_CAP_AGENTIC_HINT: Include this model in Agent, Game Agent and Quick Coder. Only models marked for multi-step tool use appear in those presets.
MODEL_MANAGER_CAP_LARGE_MOE_HINT: Mixture-of-Experts model too large for vRAM. It loads only via Phison Pascari aiDAPTIV and is hidden from every picker on machines without that hardware.
MODEL_MANAGER_CAP_TOOL_PARSER_HINT: How OpenVINO reads this model’s tool calls. The wrong parser breaks tool calling silently; leave it unset to use hermes3.
MODEL_MANAGER_PHISON_DETECTED: Phison Pascari aiDAPTIV is available on this machine.
SETTINGS_TOOLS_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: The selected model does not support tool calling.
OVMS_MTP_STALE_MODEL: {model} supports MTP, which increases inference speed. To use it, delete this model in Model management and download it again.
MODEL_MANAGER_ADD_INVALID_VISION_NAME: Enter a valid vision model (mmproj) reference.
MODEL_MANAGER_ADD_VISION_NOT_FOUND: The vision model (mmproj) repository could not be found.
MODEL_MANAGER_PUBLISHER_HINT: Recommended by the model publisher and applied automatically. They come from the catalog and cannot be edited.
ARCADE_MANAGE_DESCRIPTION: Tick a game to show it in {arcade}. Unticking only takes it off the page — the files stay in your game folder.
ARCADE_MANAGE_EMPTY: No games yet. Build one with the Game Agent.

AGENT_SETTINGS_SHARED_WITH_CHAT: Backend, device/provider, model and context size are shared with Chat mode.
AGENT_SETTINGS_THINKING_SHARED: Shared with Chat mode, where it applies to every answer.
AGENT_SETTINGS_PLANNING_ONLY_HINT: The agent thinks while it works out what to build and stops once it starts building: Game Agent follows the checklist in its plan file from then on, and Quick Coder writes its game as a second step, after the plan. Presets that do not plan think throughout.
AGENT_SETTINGS_CAPABILITIES_HINT: What the agent is equipped with, on top of its file and shell tools. Each capability adds its tools and instructions to the session.
AGENT_SETTINGS_NEXT_TURN: Changes take effect on the next turn, which starts a fresh Pi session. Attached MCP servers are started then too.
AGENT_TURN_QUEUED_DETAIL: Waiting for the running turn to finish…
AGENT_HELD_ANSWER_DISCARD_HINT: Discard this answer; {channel} is told it was not sent
HISTORY_TASK_FILTER_EMPTY: No sessions from this agent yet
AGENT_TASKS_CLOSE_CONFIRM: An agent is scheduled or still running. Keep AI Playground running in the background, or quit and stop it?
AGENT_STEPS_HINT: Run Steps works through these one turn at a time. Send skips them.
AGENT_STEPS_RUN_TIP: Run all steps, optionally with your message as extra instructions
AGENT_STEPS_SEND_TIP: Send message only (steps are not run)
AGENT_AGENTS_HINT: Pick one to load its model, tools and steps into the settings above.
AGENT_AGENTS_RUN_NOW: Run now in a new session
AGENT_PRESET_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: The Agent Preset appears with the Chat presets. Picking it opens a session set up as this agent, and its sessions are listed under it.
AGENT_PRESET_NAME_TAKEN: A preset named “{name}” already exists. Rename the agent first.
AGENT_PRESET_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the Agent Preset.
